text:
zoe: heads-up — TealWave (CFO) replied to Kara. Procurement will not accept an invoice until we provide: 1) signed MSA, 2) official PO as a PDF with their cost center and PO number, and 3) VAT exemption scan if applicable. They explicitly rejected the proforma. Any blockers on our side? :eyes:

kara: thanks. I have a draft PO in email but there's no PO number yet. CFO said the signatory needs our signed MSA before issuing the official PO. I asked legal to sign but they want the final SOW attached. Draft filename in email: `TealWave_PO_Draft_03152026.pdf`

legal-ops: we can countersign the MSA but we need the final SOW (billing amounts + dates). @kara can you confirm which SOW version they expect? Also need procurement contact for countersignature (email or Ariba ID).

maria: from billing — current state: order = ON_HOLD. Customer rejected proforma. Marked reason: missing customer PO + legal signoff. Adding billing ops into the thread.

billing-bot: Invoice status: ON_HOLD. Reason: MISSING_CUSTOMER_PO_AND_LEGAL_SIGNOFF. Proforma attempted: PF-23459 (1769998889). Next action: upload PO PDF to billing portal or provide signed MSA + SOW.

finance-bot: Finance checklist for AR ingestion:
- PO number (required)
- Billing address match
- Customer cost center (customer field)
- VAT status / exemption certificate (if EU)
- Vendor code for mapping (TVW-009)
If any field missing we cannot post the invoice into our accounting system — it will remain on hold. Also: if they claim VAT exemption we need their official certificate (PDF) and country of registration.

zoe: can we do a limited workaround and invoice onboarding fees only as a proforma? Customer explicitly refused any proforma docs at this stage.

kara: I’ll push procurement contact. They quoted procurement@tealwave.com and said Ariba upload is pending on their side. I’ll escalate to the AM to ask for a signed PDF with PO number by EOD.

legal-ops: quick note — if sales confirms SOW v3.1 we can sign the MSA today. We need the SOW doc attached to the countersignature request.

maria: Action plan from billing side:
1) Open internal billing-ticket and attach the draft PO email thread
2) Mark invoice record as 'pending PO' and include required VAT doc field
3) Notify customer that invoice will be released once PO/PDF + signed MSA are received
Please add any missing steps.

harry: FYI: if they upload via Ariba/EDI, finance needs the PO as PDF and the PO reference included in the EDI header. Finance ops will map on receipt.

kara: confirmed — SOW v3.1 is the correct one. Link: https://redwood.internal/sow/tealwave/v3.1 (internal). I’ll attach it to the countersign request.

zoe: thanks team. I’ll follow up with TealWave procurement and loop in @legal-ops & @finance-bot. If we don’t receive a signed PO by EOD I’ll escalate to the AM and CS lead. :thumbsup:
